name: Dumbbell Zottman Preacher Curl
steps: Adjust the seat so the pad supports both upper arms and begin with the dumbbells hanging in an underhand grip.
Bend your elbows to lift the weights, leaving the backs of your arms in contact with the pad.
Turn both forearms to take an overhand grip at the top of the curl.
Lower the weights slowly down the pad with palms down, then rotate back to an underhand grip at the bottom before the next repetition.
tips: Keep your wrists straight during the overhand descent rather than letting them bend back.
Avoid lifting your elbows off the pad or leaning backward to start the curl.
